title: Languages of Mauritania - Wikipedia
text: The languages of Mauritania include the four national languages, Arabic, Pulaar, Soninke and Wolof while Arabic is the sole official language. French, a former official language, is sometimes used for working, education and administration.

title: Soninke | people | Britannica.com
text: Soninke, also called Sarakole, Seraculeh, or Serahuli, a people located in Senegal near Bakel on the Sénégal River and in neighbouring areas of West Africa. They speak a Mande language of the Niger-Congo family.
